clue.text: Repeatedly fool people about one murder

indicators.note: the charade of fools and people is placed about, that is around, the single letter
repeatedly tells us to take the synonym for fool twice over

parts.note: an ass is a fool
a nation is a people
one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: A double-crossing of some idiot community ends in a killing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' is easy to read as a link meaning 'concerning'; here the fools-and-people string goes around the one.
explanation.definitionFit: An assassination is the killing of a prominent person, a particular kind of murder.

clue.text: American performing work finished with a party drink

indicators.note: the work is finished with, followed by, the remaining pieces in order

parts.note: on stage, performing, is on
to till is to work the soil
a do is a party

explanation.surface: A US actor rounds off a day's labour with a celebration and a glass.
explanation.definitionFit: Amontillado is a medium dry sherry, a type of fortified wine drink.

clue.text: E.g. note providing authorisation

parts.note: say, like e.g., introduces an example
so (soh) is a note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: A musical note gives someone permission.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone's say-so is their authority or permission for something to happen.

clue.text: Expression of admiration for this paper, occasionally

parts.note: as in 'that's some car!', some expresses admiration
the clue appeared in The Times, so this paper is the Times

explanation.surface: A self-congratulatory note in a newspaper praising itself now and then.
explanation.walkthrough: The Times crossword routinely refers to itself as 'this paper'.
explanation.definitionFit: Sometimes is an adverb synonym for occasionally, now and then.

clue.text: Is, accordingly, grabbing male's neck

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: grabbing shows the synonym holding the other letter within it

parts.note: thus means accordingly, therefore
M is the abbreviation for male; the 's is no letter

explanation.surface: A man being seized by the throat, as a consequence.
explanation.definitionFit: An isthmus is a narrow neck of land joining two larger landmasses.

clue.text: Hospital's brought in a medic for a special operation

indicators.note: the hospital letter is brought in, placed inside, the medic phrase

parts.note: a doc is a doctor, a medic
H is the abbreviation for hospital, on maps and signs; 's means has

explanation.surface: A hospital has called in a doctor for a particular surgical procedure.
explanation.definitionFit: Ad hoc is Latin for 'for this', describing something arranged for one specific purpose.

clue.text: Train leader in club with gymnastic equipment

parts.note: an iron is a type of golf club
the vaulting horse or pommel horse is gymnastic apparatus

explanation.surface: Someone heading a training session at a club equipped with gym apparatus.
explanation.definitionFit: Iron horse is an old nickname for a steam locomotive, the engine at the front pulling a train.

clue.text: Religious woman declared love

indicators.note: declared means spoken out loud, so a word sounding like the synonym is wanted

parts.note: love is nil, nothing, none, as in tennis scoring

explanation.surface: A nun professes her love.
explanation.definitionFit: A nun is a woman living under religious vows in an order.

clue.text: Reserved outside page for stuff to be published

indicators.note: the synonym for reserved goes outside, around, the single letter

parts.note: coy means shy, reserved

explanation.surface: Something kept back around a page of publishable material.
explanation.definitionFit: Copy is the journalistic term for text or matter prepared for printing.

clue.text: It could make finalist in tournament into champ

definitions.text: It could make finalist in tournament into champ

parts.words: It could make finalist in tournament into champ
parts.note: the decisive moment in a tennis final where winning one more rally clinches the title

explanation.surface: What turns a runner-up into a winner.
explanation.definitionFit: A match point is the point which, if won, wins the whole match for that player.

clue.text: Like the Titanic, basically

definitions.meaning: the sunken liner lies on the sea bed, at the very lowest point
fundamentally, in essence, when it comes down to it

explanation.definitionFit: At bottom means fundamentally, and literally describes a wreck lying on the ocean floor.

clue.text: Not the only one to succeed in firm he and I run

definitions.text: Not the only one to succeed

parts.note: Co. is the abbreviation for company, a firm
taken as written
taken as written
R is the cricket abbreviation for run

explanation.surface: Two partners running a firm together, each hoping to succeed.
explanation.definitionFit: A coheir shares an inheritance, so is one of several to succeed to an estate.

clue.text: Risky behaviour ruined me — pity is out

indicators.note: ruined suggests the following words are wrecked and rebuilt in a new order

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written
taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone laments that reckless conduct has destroyed them, with no sympathy left.
explanation.definitionFit: Impetuosity is rash, impulsive action taken without thinking of the risks.

clue.text: Scientifically unsound transformers

parts.note: pre-scientific practitioners who sought to turn base metals into gold

explanation.surface: Faulty electrical equipment.
explanation.definitionFit: Medieval alchemists tried to transmute lead into gold, a pursuit later science discredited.

clue.text: Some pigs grunt if terribly restricted

parts.note: hams are parts of pigs, so some of a pig

indicators.note: terribly suggests the word grunt is badly mangled into new order

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Pigs that grunt horribly when penned in.
explanation.definitionFit: Hamstrung means crippled or severely restricted in what one can do.

clue.text: Cast involved with trial for opera producer

indicators.note: involved suggests the two words are tangled together and reordered

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A theatre company in a court case with an opera impresario.
explanation.walkthrough: Alessandro Scarlatti wrote over a hundred operas, so 'opera producer' is a composer, not an impresario.
explanation.definitionFit: Alessandro Scarlatti was an Italian Baroque composer who wrote many operas.

clue.text: It's right and proper to be so absorbed

parts.note: apt means fitting, proper

explanation.surface: It's only correct to be wholly engrossed.
explanation.definitionFit: Rapt means completely engrossed or absorbed in something.

clue.text: Still casting line in river

indicators.note: the line letter goes in the river's name

parts.note: the Cam is the river through Cambridge

explanation.surface: An angler casting a line into a placid river.
explanation.definitionFit: Calm and still both describe water or weather undisturbed by movement.

clue.text: Love after marriage, say, in state capital

indicators.note: after places the love letter behind the marriage word

parts.note: marriage is an example of a sacrament of the church
love is zero in tennis, the letter O

explanation.surface: Romance continues after a wedding in an American capital city.
explanation.definitionFit: Sacramento is the capital city of the US state of California.

clue.text: Overturn possible indication of conceitedness

definitions.meaning: to turn over in the water, as a boat does
a large hat measurement jokingly suggests a swollen head

explanation.definitionFit: To capsize is to overturn; a big cap size suggests a big head, being conceited.

clue.text: One form of accommodation eclipses second, less expensive type

indicators.note: eclipses suggests one thing covering another, so the second letter is hidden within

parts.note: a hotel is a form of accommodation

explanation.surface: A grand place to stay outshines a cheaper option.
explanation.definitionFit: A hostel is a cheap kind of lodging, a less expensive type than a hotel.

clue.text: Place doctor temporarily in a different case

indicators.note: Latin grammatical case: changing the accusative ending to the nominative swaps the final letter

parts.note: a locum is a doctor standing in temporarily

explanation.surface: Putting a stand-in doctor on a different case.
explanation.walkthrough: Latin locum is the accusative of locus, a place; putting the word in the nominative case changes M to S.
explanation.definitionFit: Locus is Latin for place, used in English for a position or locality.

clue.text: President having difficulty at start of term —- it's part of a pattern

parts.note: James K. Polk was the eleventh President of the US
ado means fuss, trouble, difficulty

indicators.note: start of selects the opening letter of term

explanation.surface: A president running into trouble early in his term of office.
explanation.definitionFit: A polka dot is one of the round spots making up a dotted pattern.

clue.text: Advantage that's taken by 7, say

indicators.note: say indicates a word spoken, sounding like the phrase

parts.note: seven down is the religious woman, who takes the veil on entering an order

explanation.surface: A benefit enjoyed by the answer to clue 7.
explanation.walkthrough: To take the veil is to become a nun; 'a veil' said out loud is the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Avail as a noun means use or benefit, as in 'to no avail'.

clue.text: Print Camus novel, text awaiting publication

indicators.note: novel as an adjective means new, so the letters are made into something new

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A publisher instructs that a book by Albert Camus be printed.
explanation.definitionFit: A manuscript is an author's text before it is typeset and published.

clue.text: Object in front of fire!

definitions.meaning: an object is a goal or target
the firing-squad order runs 'ready, ... fire', so this word comes just before fire

explanation.definitionFit: An aim is an objective, and 'aim' is the command given just before 'fire'.

clue.text: A variable in algebra is put on this line

parts.note: x is the classic unknown or variable in algebra
taken as written

explanation.surface: Plotting an algebraic variable on a graph line.
explanation.definitionFit: An axis is a reference line on a graph along which values are plotted.

clue.text: Wise men, one after another, keeping time in authoritative way

parts.note: the Magi were the three wise men of the Nativity

indicators.note: keeping means holding the time letter inside

parts.note: serially means in a series, one after another

explanation.surface: The three wise men arriving one by one, punctual, with an air of command.
explanation.definitionFit: Magisterially means in a commanding, authoritative manner, like a master.
